titleEn: Change Minimum Characters to Satisfy One of Three Conditions
title: 满足三条件之一需改变的最少字符数
summary: 修改 a、b 中最少字符，使 a 所有字符都严格小于 b 所有字符，或 b 全小于 a，或两串都只含同一字符。
insight: 统计两串 26 个字母频次。前两条件枚举字母分界线，用前缀和计算两侧越界字符数；第三条件保留两串中合计频次最高的字母。
pitfalls: 严格小于的分界只枚举 a 到 y
修改可换成任意小写字母
第三条件要求两串共同只含同一个字符

solutions.title: 频次分界枚举
solutions.idea: 分别计算三类目标条件的最小修改代价。
steps: boundary=0..24：a>b 代价为 a 中大于 boundary 加 b 中小于等于 boundary；反向同理，取最小

code.java: class Solution { public int minCharacters(String a,String b){int[] first=new int[26],second=new int[26];for(char letter:a.toCharArray())first[letter-'a']++;for(char letter:b.toCharArray())second[letter-'a']++;int answer=a.length()+b.length();for(int letter=0;letter<26;letter++)answer=Math.min(answer,a.length()+b.length()-first[letter]-second[letter]);int prefixFirst=0,prefixSecond=0;for(int boundary=0;boundary<25;boundary++){prefixFirst+=first[boundary];prefixSecond+=second[boundary];answer=Math.min(answer,a.length()-prefixFirst+prefixSecond);answer=Math.min(answer,b.length()-prefixSecond+prefixFirst);}return answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun minCharacters(a:String,b:String):Int{val first=IntArray(26);val second=IntArray(26);for(letter in a)first[letter-'a']++;for(letter in b)second[letter-'a']++;var answer=a.length+b.length;for(letter in 0 until 26)answer=minOf(answer,a.length+b.length-first[letter]-second[letter]);var prefixFirst=0;var prefixSecond=0;for(boundary in 0 until 25){prefixFirst+=first[boundary];prefixSecond+=second[boundary];answer=minOf(answer,a.length-prefixFirst+prefixSecond,b.length-prefixSecond+prefixFirst)};return answer} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: int minCharacters(string a,string b){array<int,26> first{},second{};for(char letter:a)++first[letter-'a'];for(char letter:b)++second[letter-'a'];int answer=a.size()+b.size();for(int letter=0;letter<26;++letter)answer=min(answer,(int)a.size()+(int)b.size()-first[letter]-second[letter]);int prefixFirst=0,prefixSecond=0;for(int boundary=0;boundary<25;++boundary){prefixFirst+=first[boundary];prefixSecond+=second[boundary];answer=min(answer,(int)a.size()-prefixFirst+prefixSecond);answer=min(answer,(int)b.size()-prefixSecond+prefixFirst);}return answer;} };
